notes.subject: 2026 route opportunity - Meeker Classic
notes.body: 2026 Meeker Classic Sheepdog Championship Trials is Sept. 9-13, a five-day 40th-anniversary event with food/artisan vending and family-oriented educational attractions. Adventure Zone Gmail history shows Amy emailed trials@meekersheepdog.com in May 2023 about Jammin' Lamb Festival & Meeker Classic, so the 2026 message should be a natural check-back. Current official contact lists Executive Director Mary 'Maym' Cunningham at trials@meekersheepdog.com / 970-878-0111. This is a 2026 route opportunity; push prepaid first but do not automatically exclude pay-for-play. Sources verified Aug. 27, 2026: Meeker Classic official site and Adventure Zone Gmail.

followUps.label: 2026 Meeker route follow-up
followUps.reason: After sending the history-aware 2026 email, follow up quickly if Maym has not replied because the Sept. 9-13 event is close and aligns with the leg manager's open post-Labor-Day window.
